payload.title: Dobutsu Gradient Water-Based Pens Duo
payload.bodyHtml: Add a splash of enchantment to your page with our lovely gradient water-based pens! This duo delivers smooth, vibrant colour transitions, making every stroke a mini masterpiece. Perfect for doodling, writing, or just making your notes extra special!
Make your notes shine with our Motif Line Markers! Choose between sweet hearts or a snazzy zigzag for instant page pizzazz. Highlighting, but make it cute!
payload.title: Dobutsu Motif Line Markers

payload.bodyHtml: Roll out pure joy with our orange and pink motif line markers! Perfect for adding a playful dotted flourish to your notes and crafts. Instant cuteness, guaranteed!
payload.title: Dobutsu Pink & Yellow Pattern Rollers
Motif Line Roller Markers
payload.bodyHtml: Ditch dull lines! These adorable motif markers roll out dashed and wavy patterns. Add a playful touch to your notes and crafts with this super cute duo!

Highlight with brilliant precision! This Uni Propus Window highlighter in sunny yellow lets you see exactly where you're going, so your notes always look super neat. No more accidental overruns – just pure, radiant highlighting joy!
payload.title: UNI PROPUS WINDOW Yellow Highlighter
Dobutsu ProPus Window Green Highlighter
payload.bodyHtml: No more highlighting oopsies! This clever green marker has a window tip, so you can see exactly where you're going. Spot on!
Float through your notes with this dreamy Sky Blue highlighter! The clever window tip means no more overshooting, just perfect, precise marking every time. It's simply brilliant!
payload.title: UNI PROPUS WINDOW Sky Blue Highlighter
Dobutsu Clear-View Orange Highlighter
payload.bodyHtml: Brighten your notes with this zesty orange highlighter! Its clever window tip lets you see exactly where you’re marking, so no more wobbly lines or accidental overshoots. Perfect for making your most important points pop!
Meet your new favourite scribble-mate! This super-smooth Jetstream 0.7mm pen in White Light Blue glides across the page with brilliant black ink, turning chores into pure writing joy.
payload.title: Dobutsu Jetstream 0.7mm Light Blue Black Ink Pen

payload.bodyHtml: <p>Pop open a <strong>fluffy surprise</strong>! These adorable mofu mofu momonga message cards are just the ticket for sending a sweet note from your favourite flying squirrel.</p>
payload.title: Mofu Mofu Momonga Pop-Out Message Card

payload.bodyHtml: Craft delightful little notes with these dinky embossed mini cards! Perfect for tiny thank yous, charming place settings, or secret messages. Each pack contains 40 sheets of pure Japanese charm (55x90mm), ready for your miniature masterpieces.
payload.title: Dobutsu Embossed Mini Cards, 40 Sheets
Dobutsu Meow Stationery Clips
payload.bodyHtml: Say 'meow' to mess-free snacks! These purr-fectly adorable cat-shaped clips will keep your crisps and treats fresh with a playful paw-hold. Each set comes with two delightful felines – one sleek black, one pristine white – ready to guard your goodies. Made in Japan, they're not just cute, they're clippin' good!

payload.title: Dobutsu Dog & Cat Cable Organizers
payload.bodyHtml: Tired of cable chaos? Let these adorable dog and cat silicone bands come to the rescue! Keep your wires purr-fectly neat and tidy, or mark your belongings with a paw-some touch. Two critters, zero tangles!
Wrangle those unruly cables with a flock of fluffy friends! These adorable Shima Enaga cable ties will keep your wires neat and tidy, adding a touch of cuteness to your desk.
payload.title: Adorable Shima Enaga Cable Ties 3-Pack

payload.bodyHtml: Stick with cuteness! These 75 adorable sticky notes feature a shy little chap, ready to hold your important reminders with charm.
payload.title: Fluffy Momonga Sticky Notes

payload.bodyHtml: Purr-fectly adorable sticky notes featuring charming Japanese feline friends! Jot down your thoughts with a cheeky Daruma, a stealthy Ninja, or a mystical Miko cat. With 45 sheets of pure cuteness, these will be your new favourite way to leave a paw-some reminder.
